text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Let us go.
...To reclaim our victory.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
"Glory, fame, all of it belongs to me.
For anyone else to lay claim to it is the height of insolence."

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Therefore, I shall demonstrate it.
—That I alone am the "King."

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Bear witness...
To the moment I reign supreme as conqueror.
